title: Buttons to commands
summary: whileTrue vs onTrue, then watch the state change.

steps.title: Two kinds of button
steps.say: `whileTrue` runs the command while the button's held. `onTrue` starts it once per press.

steps.title: Open OI.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `OI` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find configureBindings
steps.say: It's in configureBindings(). Press **Ctrl+F**, type `configureBindings` and press Enter to jump to it.

steps.title: Start the robot
steps.say: Your code only runs once it's built and started.

waitFor.hint: press Start and wait for Running.

steps.title: Enable in Teleop
steps.say: Pick **Teleop** and press **Enable**. Robot code runs only while it's enabled.

steps.title: Drive it
steps.say: Hold **U** (right bumper): the state goes SPIN_UP, then SHOOT. Tap **K** (A): it drops back to SPIN_UP, then recovers.
